hook.en: The right person in the right job, guided and motivated well, with results checked against plans: these three functions complete the management cycle.

objectives.en: Explain the staffing process: recruitment, selection and training
Explain the elements of directing: supervision, motivation, leadership and communication

narration.en: The right person in the right job, guided and motivated well, with results checked against plans: these three functions complete the management cycle.

body.en: Staffing is filling and keeping filled the positions in the organisation with the right people. Steps: estimating manpower requirements; recruitment (searching for candidates and encouraging them to apply: internal sources such as promotion and transfer, external sources such as advertisement, campus recruitment and employment exchanges); selection (choosing the best: screening, tests, interviews, reference checks, medical examination, job offer, contract); placement and orientation; training and development; performance appraisal; promotion and career planning; and compensation.

say.en: Directing: instructing, guiding, motivating and leading people.

text.en: Motivation: stimulating people to act towards goals
Leadership: influencing people to strive willingly
Communication: formal and informal; barriers to overcome

narration.en: Let us build up directing on the board, one step at a time.

prompt.en: Put the needs in order from the most basic to the highest.

narration.en: Put the needs in order from the most basic to the highest.

steps.en: Physiological needs: food, shelter, basic pay
Safety needs: job security, a pension
Belongingness needs: friendship, acceptance in the team
Self-actualisation: becoming what one is capable of

explanation.en: A satisfied need no longer motivates; the next higher need takes over.

body.en: Controlling ensures that activities go according to plan. Steps: set performance standards; measure actual performance; compare actual performance with the standards; analyse deviations (focusing on significant ones: management by exception, and on key result areas); and take corrective action. Planning and controlling are inseparable: planning sets the standards and controlling checks them, so planning without controlling is meaningless and controlling without planning is blind.

explanation.en: Staffing finds and develops people, directing leads them, controlling checks results against plans.

problem.en: A target is 500 units a day; actual output is 440 units. Apply the steps of controlling.

steps.en: Compare: deviation of 60 units (12% below standard).
Analyse: is it machine breakdown, absent workers or poor materials?
Correct: repair, add a shift or retrain, and review the standard if it was unrealistic.

answer.en: A 12% shortfall: find the cause and take corrective action.
